# Kition Motion — instructions for agents

Kition Motion is a clean-room, pure-Rust motion graphics and visual effects engine targeting Adobe After Effects parity (and beyond), now Kition's `kit.motion` kit: the engine compiles to WebAssembly behind `bindings/wasm` for Kition's in-page editor, and runs headless behind `bindings/headless` for Kition's agent. See [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for the Kition-specific rules.

## Start every session here
`plan/` is maintainer-local (gitignored). Public equivalents: [`docs/`](../docs/).
1. Read `plan/STATUS.md` (current milestone, next task, running agents, blockers).
2. Read the task in `plan/execution-plan.md` §3, the relevant section of `plan/architecture.md`, and the crate README/docs you touch. Feature ids: `plan/aftereffects/feature-catalog.md`; effects: `plan/aftereffects/effects-list.md`; UI reference: `plan/aftereffects/README.md`.
3. Read [`docs/gaps.md`](../docs/gaps.md): every known shortfall, from the feature catalogue; each feature's status is in [`docs/parity/target-app-parity.md`](../docs/parity/target-app-parity.md). Fidelity, reliability and stability come before new features.
4. Follow the autonomous operation protocol (`plan/execution-plan.md` §7). Don't stop to ask.

## Non-negotiables
**Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first; its rules override everything here.** No Adobe assets, every asset licensed + attributed (`cargo xtask assets`).
- **Never crash** (AGENTS.md "Never crash"; outranks feature work: a crash loses people's work). Non-test code has no `unwrap()`/`expect()`/`panic!`/`unreachable!`/`todo!`/`unimplemented!` and no `unsafe`: return `Result` and use `?`, `ok_or`, `let … else`. Input-derived indices, slices and arithmetic use `get()` and checked/saturating math; recursion is depth-limited; locks handle poisoning. The app's last-resort guard turns an escaped panic into an error and keeps the document. Every crash fix gets a regression test. See `docs/kits.md` in the Kition repository and kition-sdk's `docs/platform/`.
- **Clean-room.** Behaviour and public docs only. No GPL/LGPL/AGPL code. ffmpeg only as an external test oracle.
- **Pure Rust.** Media codecs come from Kition Film crates (git deps behind `crates/media/media`).
- **Layering** (`cargo xtask layers`): nothing below L5 depends on egui/eframe/winit/rfd/cpal; L0–L4 build for wasm32.
- **Exact time:** `kition_motion_time::Tick` (254 016 000 000/s). Keyframe times are **layer time**.
- **Property tree:** everything animatable is a `Property` in the layer's `PropGroup` tree, addressed by paths (`transform/position`, `effects/#1/blurriness`, `@uid`).
- **Everything is a command** (`crates/engine/engine`): id, label, menu path, shortcut, params, enabled(), run(). UI, CLI, control channel and MCP dispatch by id.
- **Everything is agent-drivable:** every interactive widget registers an automation id; UI state is serde.
- **Quality gates** before every commit: `cargo xtask ci` (fmt, clippy -D warnings, tests, layers, assets, wasm).
- **Commits:** one task id per commit (`M6.3: trim paths`). Only green states.

## Running and looking at the app
- For engine or SDK work, build and test the crates directly: `cargo build -p kition-motion-kit -p kition-motion`, `cargo test --workspace`.
- For the kit's own editor, run `web/` (see its README) and look at the result there; Kition's agent drives the engine headless through `bindings/headless`.
- After Effects reference: drive AE via ExtendScript (`osascript -e 'tell application "Adobe After Effects 2026" to DoScriptFile "x.jsx"'`) and capture only AE's window (`screencapture -l <windowid>`); keep captures in `plan/aftereffects/ref/` (gitignored), never commit them, never capture the Home screen.
- Parallel agents: separate git worktrees and `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/agent-<name>`; keep every `Cargo.toml` valid (the `crates/*` glob).
